title: Shen'dar Village, the highlands and Falaath

segments.t: Turn in The Adventurer to Raan Wildwind; Accept The Great Outdoors from Raan Wildwind; Complete The Great Outdoors: Basic Campfire, Basic Campfire; Turn in The Great Outdoors to Raan Wildwind

tips.text: Raan Wildwind is at the west edge of the village. Sit by his campfire until Boosted Rest appears, about a minute.

segments.t: Accept Camping 101: Cooking from Raan Wildwind

tips.text: Camping 101: Cooking is a free 270 XP: you only need to learn Cooking from Zerril Softbreeze in the village.

segments.t: Accept Camping 101: First Aid from Raan Wildwind

tips.text: Camping 101: First Aid is handed in once your First Aid skill is high enough. Make Linen Bandages from cloth while you quest.

segments.t: Turn in The Next Step to Constable Aonda; Accept Welcome to Shen'dar Village from Constable Aonda

Complete Welcome to Shen'dar Village: Rathiril Sunlance; Accept The High Order from Rathiril Sunlance; Complete The High Order: Rathiril Sunlance; Turn in The High Order to Rathiril Sunlance; Accept A Magical Affront from Rathiril Sunlance

tips.text: Sit on the bench next to Rathiril Sunlance to start the conversation.

segments.t: Complete Welcome to Shen'dar Village: Coriella Calmbreeze

tips.text: Coriella Calmbreeze is the innkeeper at the north end of the village.

segments.t: Turn in Welcome to Shen'dar Village to Constable Aonda; Accept The Criminal Element from Constable Aonda
Accept Pilfered Windstones from Teeri Wellwind; Accept Hippogryph Harassment from Teeri Wellwind
Accept A Little Beauty from Taleen Shimmerthread
Accept The Problem With Prideclaws from Indari Sunseam
Learn Cooking from Zerril Softbreeze and turn in Camping 101: Cooking.
Accept WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable at the Bounty Available: Vulgara the Insatiable!
Train at your class trainer in Shen'dar Village if you have new ranks.

actions.label: Train at your class trainer in Shen'dar Village if you have new ranks.

segments.t: Complete A Magical Affront: 6 Windshaper Novice Seer

tips.text: The Novice Seers stand in the open highlands just west of the village. They are casters, so close the gap fast.

segments.t: Complete The Problem With Prideclaws: 10 Prideclaw Pelt

tips.text: Prideclaws roam the whole highlands. Pick up pelts from here on whenever one is in your way; you don't need a dedicated loop.

segments.t: Turn in A Magical Affront to Rathiril Sunlance
Complete The Criminal Element: 10 Highlands Bandit, "Badwind" Bennic; Complete Pilfered Windstones: 10 Pilfered Windstone

tips.text: Highlands Bandits camp north of Shen'dar. Badwind Bennic is at the far end of their camp and drops a windstone too.

segments.t: Turn in The Criminal Element to Constable Aonda; Turn in Pilfered Windstones to Teeri Wellwind; Accept Infiltrating the Cult from Constable Aonda
Turn in Infiltrating the Cult to Sania Silverstream; Accept Falaath Village from Sania Silverstream
Complete WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable: Vulgara's Head

tips.text: Vulgara the Insatiable is a single level 8 rare-style mob south of the village. Pull her alone.

segments.t: Complete Hippogryph Harassment: 8 Hippogryph Youth, 6 Hippogryph Protector, Hippogryph Matriarch; Complete A Little Beauty: 8 Hippogryph Down

tips.text: Hippogryph Down feathers lie on the ground among the nests. The Matriarch stands at the west end of the area.

segments.t: Turn in Falaath Village to Missionary Jasaan; Accept Among the Faithful from Missionary Jasaan
Complete Among the Faithful: Wardrobe

tips.text: Walk through Falaath Village with the Mark of Akir up; the cult leaves you alone. Inspect the wardrobe in the house.

segments.t: Turn in A Little Beauty to Taleen Shimmerthread
Turn in Hippogryph Harassment to Teeri Wellwind
Turn in WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable to Danarii Bellowveil
Turn in The Problem With Prideclaws to Indari Sunseam
Turn in Among the Faithful to Constable Aonda; Accept Havoc in the Highlands from Constable Aonda; Accept The Western Watch from Constable Aonda
Accept Stolen Supplies from Danarii Bellowveil
Train before going back into Falaath.

actions.label: Train before going back into Falaath.

segments.t: Complete Havoc in the Highlands: 6 Al'Aketh Stormcaller, 4 Living Lightning; Complete Stolen Supplies: 10 Stolen Shen'dar Supplies

tips.text: This time the cult is hostile. The Stolen Supplies drop from the Stormcallers you kill for Havoc in the Highlands.

segments.t: Complete Havoc in the Highlands: Commander Cyclas's Head

tips.text: Commander Cyclas waits at the south end of the village. Clear around him first.

segments.t: Complete The Western Watch: Peacekeeper Vaaniel; Turn in The Western Watch to Peacekeeper Vaaniel; Accept A Last Request from Peacekeeper Vaaniel
Complete A Last Request: Skypriest Aanders, Bloody Note, Raani's Lucky Feather, Shadowsong Family Signet

tips.text: Kill Skypriest Aanders by the tower, then loot the note and the two keepsakes from the bodies around it.

segments.t: Turn in Stolen Supplies to Danarii Bellowveil
Turn in Havoc in the Highlands to Constable Aonda; Turn in A Last Request to Constable Aonda; Accept To Valanaar from Constable Aonda; Accept Deliver the Signet from Constable Aonda
Complete Camping 101: First Aid: Naleeia Tattermend; Turn in Camping 101: First Aid to Naleeia Tattermend

tips.text: Hand this in at Naleeia Tattermend once your First Aid is high enough; skip it if you are not there yet.

segments.t: Last training in Shen'dar. Valanaar has every trainer from here on.

actions.label: Last training in Shen'dar. Valanaar has every trainer from here on.

tips.text: The run to Valanaar is long. Use it to drink up and sell; there is no flight path on the island.
